original.reason: It asserts the key compact-closure neighborhood lemma without proving it; that lemma is the substantive step needed for regularity.

judgment.reason: It correctly uses compactness and finite Hausdorff separations to obtain an open V with closure contained in U, then separates a point from a closed set.
The compact-set finite-subcover argument correctly proves point--closed-set separation.
It gives a complete correct compactness-and-Hausdorffness proof of regularity.
Its key assertion that local compactness applied to U supplies a suitable W is not justified, and the compactness argument is only sketched without establishing the necessary containment W⊆U.
